text:
cam: quick sync — did: pushed microbatch slotting tweak (PR #492). Observed a ~1% p99 spike on 8k seqs in canary.
lee: saw it, thanks. re-running the bench with cpu profiler now. @cam can you share the canary host id?
cam: canary host is canary-rt-7. quick trace snippet:
```
perf record -o perf.data -p 4182 -g -- sleep 60
perf script | head -n 40
# shows heavy time in slot_allocator::acquire_lock
```
sam: fwiw KV metrics show eviction rate up since the microbatcher rollout — threshold still at 0.7 in canary. lowering to 0.6 earlier helped eviction but bumped tail for long seqs.
rachel: I can flip the eviction threshold on a single shard for an A/B — want me to run that against shard-3 on canary-rt-7?
cam: yes please. start A on shard-3. also @deploy-bot did a small rollout earlier?
deploy-bot: Canary rollout complete: microbatcher v0.12.1 -> canary-rt-7 at 11:02 UTC. No automated alerts triggered.
lee: uploaded profiler flame: https://internal/flames/1762508123 — early suspect is lock contention around slot allocator
sam: i have a tiny patch that reduces lock hold time, will open PR (WIP) and bench locally. expecting low risk.
cam: can someone give quick review if sam posts? plan: get trace -> apply sam patch -> run microbench -> decide rollback/tune.
rachel: paging infra to get kernel-level strace with timestamps for pid 4182, pinging now, ETA ~20m.
lee: also going to run a synthetic with kv-hot-prefix to isolate prefix cache behavior, will post numbers.
sam: PR will be posted in ~10m, ping me for review after tests pass.
cam: thanks all. blockers: need infra trace + 1 reviewer for sam's PR. i'll update when trace lands.
rachel: infra acked, will attach strace & perf tarball here when available. :white_check_mark:
cam: nice. marking follow-ups: #1 triage trace, #2 review+merge sam PR, #3 run canary microbench. ping here with results. :rocket:
